name: freelancer_com-mcp
description: Freelancer.com (jobs): search, get_posting, list_messages. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_freelancer_com_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCER_COM_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_freelancer_com_access_token.description: Freelancer OAuth access token sent as the freelancer-oauth-v1 header: a Personal Access Token from https://accounts.freelancer.com/settings/develop ('valid for thirty days') or a token from your registered OAuth app.

tools.name: search
tools.description: GET /projects/0.1/projects/active/ ('Searches for active projects', scope basic): query is space-separated terms over names and descriptions; limit/offset page the results; full_description=true returns the whole text. Freelancer projects are contracts, not employment: salary_min/max are budget.minimum/maximum in currency.code (fixed or hourly per `type`). time_submitted (Unix), owner_id, seo_url and jobs stay in raw. No location text filter (latitude/longitude only).

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: GET /messages/0.1/messages/ (scope fln:messaging) filtered by threads[]=thread_id. The sender (from_user) is a numeric user id and time_created is Unix time; both stay in raw.
